Polling suggests that a blue wave is looking very likely for the Democrats in the 2026 midterms. 

This means Democrats will have the power to run investigations into members of Trump's cabinet and maybe impeach President Trump himself. Puck News’s Marianna Sotomayor talks to Vox’s Today, Explained about how the Democrats are gaming their possible majority. Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
